content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a digital storefront using COREMERCH's infrastructure that allows for immediate crypto payment processing. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, the process is streamlined. By deploying a basic stack with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can have your site live in hours. Integrating automatic payments through NOWPayments ensures you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, opening up your sales to a global audience. This is achievable without the need for traditional banking infrastructure, allowing you to focus on your products and customers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your entry point. For $97, you receive a functional e-commerce setup that includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. This stack is set up to handle three products initially, which is ideal for creators just getting started. Within 48 hours, you can have your digital products ready for sale, enabling you to test the waters and refine your offerings without upfront costs or commitments to traditional platforms.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on deploying your store first before getting bogged down by advanced features. You don’t need to worry about complex marketing strategies or extensive inventory management at this stage. Concentrate on your product's presentation and payment processing. Once your basic stack is running, you can scale and add features like analytics or customer engagement tools as needed. This approach ensures you launch quickly and adjust based on actual customer feedback rather than theoretical planning.
Take control of your digital sales with infrastructure that empowers you.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, follow these simple steps: launch your site, set up your product listings, and ensure your NOWPayments integration is functioning correctly. Promote your store through social media or local channels to generate interest. Remember, USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for minimal fees, making it an excellent option for quick transactions. Once the first sale comes in, you’ll have the momentum and validation needed to expand your product line and reach new customers.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, your priority should be to finalize your product listings and launch your store. Use the resources available in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to streamline your setup, as it includes all the blueprints and templates necessary for a professional storefront. Additionally, explore Binance P2P for crypto transactions to ensure you are accepting payments in local currencies like Naira, Cedis, or Kenyan Shillings. This will enhance your accessibility to local customers and enable seamless transactions.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Blockchain payments eliminate reliance on traditional financial systems.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

Yes, platforms like Binance P2P support transactions in local currencies such as Naira, Cedis, and Kenyan Shillings, making it easier for local customers to purchase your products.
